newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia RTS shares index rises to record 347.11.
newsitem.headline: Russia RTS shares index rises to record 347.11.

text.p: The Russian Trading System (RTS) 24-share index rose 5.24 percent to close at a record 347.11 at close on Wednesday from 329.83 at Tuesday's close, the NAUFOR brokers association said.
It said total reported market volume was a strong $65.65 million.
* Utilities and leading shares showed the highest share turnover volumes though top price gainers were mixed between regional utilities, oil companies, telecoms and prefs.
* Traders said demand was still high and stock difficult to source across most sectors, predicting the RTS index would rise another few percentage points on Thursday.
* Regional utilities and telecoms were seen as strong potential performers on Thursday.
* Lenenergo utility eased back to $0.804 from an intraday high of $1.050 and $0.880 at Tuesday's close.
* National utility UES ordinaries had almost $10 million turnover and rose to $0.2525 from $0.2335.
* Mosenergo edged up to $1.555 from $1.511 on over $7 million turnover.
